types.name: AssemblyJointInterface
types.doc: Candidate occurrence hulls on opposite sides of a mechanical joint.

types.name: AssemblyPartLink
types.doc: Where a part rides: link `link`, at `offset` (metres) in the link's frame.

types.name: AssemblyPhysicalPartView
types.doc: One physical-part view shared by simulation and future collision planning.

fields.name: massProperties
fields.doc: Resolved homogeneous-part mass properties in SI, preserving declared physical overrides.

types.name: AssemblySimulationBridge
types.doc: Converts an assembly's tree joints and physical parts to a RobotKit model.

types.name: AssemblySimulationModel
types.doc:
An assembly as one simulated robot. Parts that fixed joints hold together form one rigid body and
share a link; parts fixed to the world share the root link. Lengths are metres.

types.name: AssemblySimulationSubtree
types.doc: A detached CAD subtree rebased at its named root, with its current pose retained separately.

types.name: BeltResonanceCalibration
types.doc:
Reviewable, stale-checked update. One measurement identifies one common rigidity correction for an explicit belt group;
it cannot identify the individual CoreXY belts. Mass/inertia and mode attribution remain model inputs.

fields.name: encode
fields.doc: Standalone overlay also works for source-defined printers with code-only, non-rebuildable CAD members.

fields.name: applySaved
fields.doc: Replay only against the assembly AND physical model used for the fit, including its mass assumptions.

fields.name: apply
fields.doc: Explicit local model update, with no firmware writes.

types.name: BimFrameBridge
types.doc:
Registers a BimKit document's spatial aggregation hierarchy
(project -> site -> building -> storey, `bimkit.BimSchema.Aggregates`
edges) as `FrameTree3` edges, named `"bim:" + elementId.value`. Project/
site/building objects carry no geometry of their own (they are generic
classified CadKit objects, not features), so their edges are identity; a
storey with a base Level gets a Z-only translation from that level's
elevation, converted from BimKit's millimeters into RobotKit's meters.

types.name: CadCollision
types.doc:
CAD geometry in a collision description (COLLISION.md CL3a): mechanisms
as articulations posed from their own model (through RobotKit, from
`AssemblySimulationBridge.toRobotModel`), and parts and fixtures at their
world pose as hulls, surface meshes or decomposed solids.

fields.name: describeMechanism
fields.doc: A CAD mechanism, converted to a RobotKit model, with its link hulls (CAD-sourced).

fields.name: describePart
fields.doc:
A fixed part at `pose` (CAD units, scaled by `metresPerUnit`) in
`group`; returns its described objects. Decomposition needs a
`decomposer` and caches through `cache`.

types.name: CadCollisionMesh
types.doc: A tessellation as flat arrays, in metres.

fields.name: fingerprint
fields.doc: A content key: counts and a hash of every coordinate and index.

types.name: CadDecompositionCache
types.doc: Decompositions per part, kept with the parts so a part is decomposed again only when it changes (CL-D11).

fields.name: get
fields.doc: The cached decomposition of `mesh` for `part`, or a new one; the key covers the mesh's contents.

types.name: CadPartCollision
types.doc: How a CAD part enters a collision description (CL-D8: solids are convex, meshes are surfaces).

fields.name: Hull
fields.doc: A convex hull (x, y, z triples in CAD units, e.g. `AssemblyPhysicalPart.collisionHull`, an enclosing hull).

fields.name: Surface
fields.doc: The part's tessellation as a surface mesh: floors, walls, sheet.

fields.name: Decomposed
fields.doc: A non-convex solid as convex pieces (CL-D11), inflated to enclose its tessellation.

types.name: CellCadObservation
types.doc: CAD geometry and its observed world pose remain source facts until description building.

types.name: CellCollisionSnapshot
types.doc: Geometry and live poses collected once, before choosing a collision consumer.

fields.name: mechanism
fields.doc: Other controllers remain independent geometry at their supplied live poses.

fields.name: object
fields.doc: A loose or physically carried object; the caller supplies observed ownership.

fields.name: fixture
fields.doc: Fixed installed geometry, including deposited metal, at its current world pose.

fields.name: part
fields.doc: Installed CAD at its actual pose, through the canonical CAD collision adapter.

fields.name: at
fields.doc: The same fixed cell geometry viewed from another robot parking pose.

fields.name: fromAssembly
fields.doc: CAD assembly parts use their actual posed hulls and exported mechanism ownership.

fields.name: fixedBounds
fields.doc: Fixed world bounds for floor navigation, derived from the same captured hulls.

fields.name: describe
fields.doc: Build in the compiled model's cell frame, without changing the captured geometry.

types.name: CellHullObservation
types.doc: Live geometry observations exist only before building the shared description.

types.name: EndEffectorBridge
types.doc: Convert one end-effector working frame into a RobotKit tool.

types.name: EndEffectorChangerRuntimeBundle
types.doc: All CAD-declared changer tools sharing one measured lock and runtime selection.

types.name: EndEffectorCollision
types.doc: Conservative per-member convex pieces in the robot flange frame.

types.name: EndEffectorCollisionOptions
types.doc:
Geometry policy, in millimetres except for the piece limit. Small members
merge only when within minFeature of another piece; maxPieces forces merges.

types.name: EndEffectorControlBinding
types.doc: Digital process channel bound to an actuator inlet in a coupled configuration.

fields.name: Driver
fields.doc: An arc torch's trigger. The arc is worked by the robot's welder (RobotKit's `SimulatedWelder`), not by a tool runtime.

types.name: EndEffectorRuntimeBridge
types.doc: Build the mounted runtime and its output channels for one coupled EOAT.

fields.name: deriveBindings
fields.doc: Build control channels and pressure feedback from component port intents.

fields.name: toRuntimeFromDesign
fields.doc: Build a runtime using only declarations on the coupled components.

fields.name: toChangerRuntimeFromDesign
fields.doc: Build all CAD changer configurations; omitting the lock uses an in-memory simulation lock.

fields.name: addVacuumSensorToBlueprint
fields.doc:
Add the design's pressure sensor to a robot blueprint before simulation
creation. Its mount is expressed relative to the flange link.

fields.name: bindSensors
fields.doc: Register declared pressure feedback on a selected runtime.

types.name: EndEffectorVacuumFeedback
types.doc:
Deterministic pressure feedback from simulation contact on one cup piece.
Geometric touch is a seal proxy; this model has no leakage or evacuation time.

fields.name: attach
fields.doc: Register for every explicit private or joined-session step.

fields.name: sample
fields.doc: Publish one authored sensor frame and update the selected tool.

types.name: MachineAssemblyMassBridge
types.doc: Maps a complete MachineKit mass rollup into RobotKit's SI conventions.

types.name: SuctionCapacityBridge
types.doc: Turn a connected MachineKit cup into a RobotKit holding-force check.

types.name: AuthPrincipal
types.doc: Authenticated identity and independent authorization grants.

types.name: ClientCredentials
types.doc: Explicit bearer credentials. They are never synthesized by a client or server.

types.name: RobotAuthorization
types.doc: Strict, versioned operator configuration. No anonymous or loopback fallback.

types.name: HoldJointBehavior
types.doc: Minimal reusable joint behavior used by simulation and replay tests.

types.name: IntentBuffer
types.doc: Bounded latest-intent buffer; stale behavior output is discarded.

types.name: JointTargetIntent
types.doc: One expiring joint command emitted by a Haxeon behavior.

fields.name: expiryNs
fields.doc: Absolute same-process monotonic deadline; zero means no expiry.

types.name: RobotBehavior
types.doc: Haxeon behavior executed by robotd from published robot snapshots.

types.name: RobotBehaviorRunner
types.doc: Runs one behavior against each new snapshot and returns its live intent.

types.name: RobotContext
types.doc: Read-only snapshot plus bounded intent output exposed to a behavior.

types.name: WorldBehavior
types.doc: Application behavior that only sees RobotWorld's transport-neutral state.

types.name: WorldBehaviorContext
types.doc: Read-only application input plus bounded command output for one robot.

types.name: WorldBehaviorRunner
types.doc: Runs identical application behavior against simulated or remote adapters.

types.name: RobotClient
types.doc:
Typed editor/CLI client for the RobotKit process boundary.

The client owns only transport and protocol state. RobotRuntime state remains
authoritative in robotd and is delivered as immutable message values.

fields.name: subscribeCamera
fields.doc: Add camera before connect when full images are needed.

fields.name: connect
fields.doc: Connects to robotd and starts the NativeKit event subscription.

fields.name: connectWithEvents
fields.doc:
Connects using an event pump owned by an embedding application.

This keeps the editor's single NativeKit initialization and event loop
authoritative while retaining the same typed client API.

fields.name: poll
fields.doc: Pumps all currently queued NativeKit events and reports whether any ran.

fields.name: wait
fields.doc: Waits for transport activity; call poll() afterwards to dispatch it.

fields.name: requestDeployment
fields.doc: Requires the authenticated deployment grant; the host must have no active controller.

fields.name: sendJointTargets
fields.doc: Sends a complete position/velocity/effort batch as one protocol frame.

fields.name: resetSafety
fields.doc: Acknowledges the current safety stop and asks robotd to reset it.

types.name: CollisionClearance
types.doc:
Point and motion clearance against one CollisionDescription. Standalone
hull fixtures use the shared builder before entering this adapter.
Kinematics supply body poses and conservative motion bounds; CollisionKit
owns geometry, pair rules, margins, and transfers of held bodies.
Temporary contact windows scope a margin or permission to one named pair.

fields.name: MARGIN
fields.doc: The distance bodies must keep, in metres.

fields.name: CONTACT_MARGIN
fields.doc: The distance a tool body must keep from fixed bodies where it works, in metres.

fields.name: placementClear
fields.doc: Exact placement clearance against an authored obstacle description.

fields.name: combine
fields.doc: Combines scene fragments; geometry and role information stay in the description.

fields.name: shapes
fields.doc: Shapes on a named link, with explicit tool identity and margin classes.

fields.name: vertices
fields.doc: Finite, link-local points for motion bounds; queries retain exact geometry.

fields.name: new
fields.doc: The complete described cell and its kinematic mapping; every fixture builds a description first.

fields.name: copyForGroup
fields.doc: A concrete owned copy, for callers responsible for the native world's lifetime.

fields.name: bodyIndex
fields.doc: The described body index used by displacement/envelope arrays for a named object.

types.name: CollisionClearanceLayout
types.doc: The description plus its mechanical carrier mapping; policy stays in the description.

types.name: CollisionOwner
types.doc: Ownership is independent of a hull's name and its pose in a snapshot.

types.name: CollisionOwnership
types.doc: Ownership and tool identity supplement the collision description; geometry does not.

types.name: CollisionSceneBuilder
types.doc:
One cell description for static, process and conservative motion checks.
Poses and ownership are supplied by the current CAD or simulation snapshot;
fixtures and loose stock never become part of an articulation merely by
intersecting its reference pose. Named pair data owns contact permissions.

fields.name: identify
fields.doc: Ownership facts for an object already emitted by a canonical source adapter.

fields.name: addGeometry
fields.doc: Primitives and CAD hulls share the description's ownership and pair-policy path.

fields.name: payload
fields.doc: Held parts cannot inherit structural or reference-overlap exemptions.

fields.name: memberObjects
fields.doc: Every convex piece of the supplied physical CAD members, without interpreting object names.

fields.name: register
fields.doc: Register identities emitted by a source adapter; the description retains all geometry.

fields.name: clearance
fields.doc: The same geometry and named pair policy through RobotKit's process adapter.

types.name: RobotCollision
types.doc:
A RobotKit robot's collision geometry (COLLISION.md CL3a): one body per
link from the compiled model, the kit's rigid, adjacent and closure pairs
as rules, link primitives and hulls, the tool on a body of its own group
following its flange link (hull padding as inflation), and the robot as
one articulation at its reference configuration.

Contact settings are mapped per CL-D10: `ShapeContact` and the
blueprint's self-collision opt-out are simulation-only and are recorded as
ignored; each `ContactPair` becomes an allow rule with the reason
"declared contact". A link's mesh reference (`collisionGeometry`) is
recorded and left out: meshes are not loaded.

fields.name: addDescriptionShapes
fields.doc: Adds another description's carried shapes to this robot's model/tool bodies.

fields.name: simulationExcludes
fields.doc:
The robot's link pairs the simulation should exclude (COLLISION.md CL3b,
CL-D10): link index pairs (two per pair) between which some object pair
is allowed in the built world (or that carry no objects), the tool
counting as its flange link. Passed to `Simulation.addRobotAtPose
(linkExcludes)`, the simulation excludes these pairs instead of computing
its own. Excludes are per link, rules per object: a link pair with one
allowed object pair is excluded whole, so the simulation may exclude
more than the clearance world, never fewer (CL-D10).

types.name: RobotCollisionBodies
types.doc: A robot in a `CollisionDescription`: its model bodies, and the described objects of its shapes, hulls and tool.

fields.name: shapes
fields.doc: Per link, the described objects of its shapes, in `collisionShapes` order.

fields.name: sourceObjects
fields.doc: Stable object ids of explicitly supplied live source shapes.

fields.name: toolBody
fields.doc: The tool's described body (following its flange link), or -1.

fields.signature: (robot:RobotModel, model:KinematicModel, bodies:ModelBodies, shapes:Array<Array<Int>>, hulls:Array<Int>, toolBody:Int, toolObjects:Array<Int>, sourceObjects:Array<Int>):Void

fields.name: linkBody
fields.doc: The described body of a link.

types.name: RobotCollisionOptions
types.doc: How `RobotCollision.describe` places and groups a robot.

fields.name: linkGroup
fields.doc: Pair-class groups (CL-D4) of the links and of the tool.

fields.name: fixedBase
fields.doc: A robot bolted down: its root link, and what is rigid to it, is fixed in the cell.

fields.name: rootPose
fields.doc: Where the robot's root sits in the cell (identity when null).

fields.name: reference
fields.doc: The reference configuration, as DOF values of the compiled model (zero, within limits, when null).

fields.name: referenceName
fields.doc: What the reference is called in the report (e.g. "home").

fields.name: toolFrame
fields.doc: The flange frame the tool's geometry is in; else `toolLink`'s frame.

fields.name: selfCollision
fields.doc: The runtime blueprint's self-collision flag: simulation-only, recorded when off (CL-D10).

fields.name: declareArticulation
fields.doc: A cell builder can add follower bodies before declaring the articulation.

types.name: RobotLinkShape
types.doc: A named source shape on a robot link, using the shared CollisionShape vocabulary.

fields.name: group
fields.doc: Optional margin class on a follower body; -1 keeps the link's class.

types.name: CoupledJoint
types.doc:
A robot joint that moves with another: joint `follower`'s position is
`ratio * leader + offset`, by index into the robot description's joints and
in SI units. A lead screw turning with its carriage is one.

types.name: ExecutionCapabilities
types.doc: Limits and contracts of buffered execution; zero limits mean no plan support.

fields.name: polynomialLimits
fields.doc:
Validation of declared position, velocity and acceleration limits.
Jerk remains a separate plan claim, represented by jerkUnchecked.

fields.name: new
fields.signature: (plans:Bool, maximumPolynomialDegree:Int, maximumJoints:Int, maximumSegments:Int, timedEvents:Bool, replacementBoundaries:Bool, holdResume:Bool, polynomialLimits:ValidationGuarantee):Void

types.name: ForceTorqueMeasurement
types.doc:
One fresh SI force/torque observation. Values are the external wrench acting
on the sensor, in N and N*m, expressed at the named sensor frame; source and
mapped robot-clock timestamps stay with the wrench.

fields.name: fromFrame
fields.doc: Parse one mounted sensor sample and prove its entire clock interval is fresh.

types.name: ImmutableFloatArray
types.doc: Owning, read-only view over a finite sequence of floating-point values.

fields.name: toArray
fields.doc: Returns independent mutable storage for adapters or serialization.

types.name: ImmutableSensorArray
types.doc: Read-only collection of sensor frames, which are immutable and so shared, not copied.

types.name: JointTarget
types.doc: Immutable target for one joint inside an atomic RobotCommand batch.

fields.name: MAX_BATCH_SIZE
fields.doc: Maximum targets accepted by the fixed-size RobotRuntime ABI.

fields.name: servoVelocity
fields.doc: Servo terms, used only in Servo mode, in the joint's SI units.

fields.name: servo
fields.doc:
A joint servo: effort = stiffness * (position - q) + damping *
(velocity - qdot) + feedforward, applied every physics step and clamped to
the joint's effort limit.

fields.name: copyBatch
fields.doc: Validates and copies a complete batch so callers cannot mutate it mid-submit.

types.name: JointTargetMode
types.doc: Interpretation of a joint target value, independent of its transport.

fields.name: Servo
fields.doc: Position target with velocity target, stiffness, damping and feedforward effort.

types.name: Robot
types.doc:
Common live-robot boundary for physical and simulated robots.

RobotWorld depends only on this contract, so behavior code can be reused
with a RemoteRobot, SimulatedRobot, replay adapter, or hardware endpoint.

fields.name: resetSafety
fields.doc: Explicit application acknowledgement that permits clearing a safety latch.

types.name: RobotCapabilities
types.doc: Immutable transport-independent capabilities with bounded execution contracts.

types.name: RobotCommand
types.doc: Transport-independent commands accepted by a logical robot.

fields.name: JointTargets
fields.doc:
One atomic set of position, velocity, and/or effort targets.
`expiryNs` (null/zero: none) is a deadline on the robot's source clock
(`RobotSnapshot.sourceTimestampNs`): after it, the batch's velocity
targets lapse and those joints brake to zero within their acceleration
limits. In-process robots enforce it in the runtime; remote ones reject
it until host and robot clocks are mapped.

fields.name: ExecutionPlan
fields.doc: Submit or replace a revision-bound execution plan.

fields.name: Hold
fields.doc: Pause the native path clock while retaining its queue.

fields.name: Resume
fields.doc: Resume a held native path.

fields.name: Abort
fields.doc: Controlled straight-ramp stop that discards the path.

types.name: RobotDescription
types.doc: Transport-independent description of a logical robot.

fields.name: couplings
fields.doc: Joints that move with another joint, such as lead screws with their axes.

types.name: RobotEvent
types.doc: Bounded, per-robot event stream. Ordinals are local to one robot.

types.name: RobotEventRing
types.doc: Owner-thread ring. A slow reader gets one gap marker before retained events.

fields.name: skip
fields.doc: Reserve ordinals for observations lost before this boundary.

fields.name: restore
fields.doc: Used by replay; stored ordinals must remain strictly increasing.

types.name: RobotFault
types.doc: Transport-independent fault reported by a logical robot.

types.name: RobotHealthSummary
types.doc: Aggregate health counts; it contains no adapter references.

types.name: RobotId
types.doc: Stable semantic identity of a robot within a world.

types.name: RobotSensorFrames
types.doc: Shared projection of measured runtime state, never synthesized sensor data.

types.name: RobotSnapshot
types.doc: Transport-independent immutable observation of one logical robot.

fields.name: safety
fields.doc: Current runtime safety state: ready, stopping, emergency-stop, or fault.

fields.name: trajectoryQueueDepth
fields.doc: Number of timestamped trajectory points currently owned by the runtime.

fields.name: trajectoryActive
fields.doc: Whether the runtime is currently consuming a timestamped trajectory.

fields.name: trajectoryTimeNs
fields.doc: Runtime trajectory clock, in the runtime's owner timebase.

fields.name: trajectoryDurationNs
fields.doc: Timestamp of the last point currently owned by the runtime.

fields.name: trajectoryTag
fields.doc: Stable identity of the chunk currently running or last stopped.

fields.name: trajectoryTagTimeNs
fields.doc: Time within trajectoryTag, in nanoseconds.

fields.name: setpointPositions
fields.doc:
Where the robot holds each joint and anchors the next plan: the last
commanded position, which a measured position may miss by a step or a
following error. A plan started while idle begins here. Equals
`positions` where the source does not report it.

fields.name: timestampNs
fields.doc: Compatibility alias; new code should name the clock explicitly.

types.name: SensorFrame
types.doc: One immutable sensor observation shared by simulated and remote robots.

fields.name: image
fields.doc: Pixels for camera observations; immutable, so copies share it.

fields.name: copy
fields.doc: The frame itself: it is immutable, so a copy could never differ from it.

types.name: SensorMount
types.doc: Immutable authored sensor pose, shared by observations of the same sensor.

types.name: StopMode
types.doc: Safety meaning of a world-level stop request.

types.name: TimingCapabilities
types.doc: Deadline enforcement and mapping to the endpoint's explicit source clock.

types.name: PerceptionPipelineConfig
types.doc: Validated deployment data. Pipeline implementation is selected in code.

types.name: SerialDeployment
types.doc:
A canonical semantic robot model plus its physical device configuration: which board it is for
(`controller`) and how its channels are wired (`binding`, derived from the model and the layout).

fields.name: binding
fields.doc: The channel layout derived from the model and the wiring, with the tightened model to plan on.

fields.name: controller
fields.doc: Unique id of the board this deployment is for: 32 lowercase hex digits.

types.name: BoundChannel
types.doc: One RKD6 channel as the device sees it: a stepper actuator's transmission into a joint, in steps.

fields.name: ratio
fields.doc: Device actuator coordinate per joint unit; negative when the driver is wired reversed.

fields.name: maxRate
fields.doc: Continuous actuator-rate ceiling before `minStepTicks` quantizes it to controller periods.

fields.name: minStepTicks
fields.doc: The least whole step-tick periods between steps, which the device enforces (`StepTicks`).

fields.name: feedbackJointIndex
fields.doc: Original physical shaft mapping, before collapsing its leader coupling.

fields.name: holdStiffness
fields.doc: The stiffness the actuator holds its shaft joint with and the inertia that joint turns (see `VirtualActuatorOptions`).

types.name: BoundInput
types.doc: An input channel joined to the physical actuator whose step count it captures.

types.name: DeviceBinding
types.doc:
The join of a machine model and a deployment's wiring into the device's actuator layout. The
model owns the motor's full steps and the transmission; the layout owns which channel drives
which actuator and its direction. Microstepping is a model driver setting; the board owns the step tick.
Nothing falls back to a default: a stepper without a channel, or a channel without a stepper,
is an error.

fields.name: model
fields.doc:
A copy of the model whose stepper actuators are no faster than the step tick can drive them,
so the limits planning reads from it (RobotModel.coupledLimits) are the device's real ceiling.

fields.name: planningModel
fields.doc: Controller rate ceilings for host planning; GPIO deployment is not implied.

fields.name: virtualInputs
fields.doc: Ideal physical switches, quantized conservatively to an emitted step boundary.

fields.name: virtualActuators
fields.doc: The channels as an in-process virtual device's actuators.

types.name: DeviceChannel
types.doc: One hardware channel, naming the model actuator it drives.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: 1, or -1 when the driver is wired in reverse.

fields.name: skewBound
fields.doc: Largest tolerated disagreement after pulse counts are normalized to SI leader coordinates.

types.name: DeviceHomingSides
types.doc: One owner serializes acknowledged physical side controls for a wired device.

fields.name: install
fields.doc: Bind protocol-backed input sensors and side control to a serial or virtual runtime.

fields.name: controlledStop
fields.doc: Return false when ordinary stopping applies outside a physical pair scope.

types.name: DeviceInput
types.doc: Deployment wiring for a physical switch; thresholds remain machine-model data.

types.name: DeviceLayout
types.doc:
Physical-channel mapping and driver wiring, kept separate from the semantic RobotModel. Each
wired channel names a model actuator and its direction; DeviceBinding joins them.

fields.name: forActuators
fields.doc: One channel per actuator; dual drives inherit their leader's stated racking tolerance.

fields.name: forSteppers
fields.doc: Pulse channels cover only steppers; servo limits remain in their motor/driver model.

types.name: DeviceSwitchSensorAdapter
types.doc: Publish physical device switch captures on the runtime's external sensor stream.

fields.name: poll
fields.doc: Called after copying joint state; never advances the device clock.

types.name: DeviceTransmission
types.doc: Resolve complete one-leader transmission chains for RKD's physical channel grouping.

types.name: DeviceTransmissionMapping
types.doc: Actuator = ratio * (independent joint - offset), in SI coordinates.

types.name: ExecutionPlanPurpose
types.doc: Admission category carried with a plan through copies and streaming.

types.name: ExecutionPlanSubmission
types.doc: Immutable plan metadata and bounded polynomial payload for a runtime session.

fields.name: controlAcceleration
fields.doc: Requested acceleration for controlled stop/resume, zero for physical limits.

fields.name: segments
fields.doc: The payload, copied out of `arrays` on first use when the plan came as arrays.

fields.name: arrays
fields.doc: The payload as native arrays an in-process runtime reads in place, or null.
